'''2024 NAC Jonny Chu DS No Money, No Parts, No Deal!''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Jonny Chu]] at [[2024 North American Continental Championship]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Jonny Chu]]
* '''Event:''' [[2024 North American Continental Championship]]
